# domeneshop_dns_records (Data Source)

Read a domain's existing DNS records, optionally narrowed by host and type. Useful for referencing records you do not manage with Terraform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric id of the domain to read records from.

### Optional

- `host` (String) Only return records for this host.
- `type` (String) Only return records of this type. One of `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `SRV`, `TLSA`, `TXT`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) The matching records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `data` (String) The record value.
- `domain_id` (Number) The domain the record belongs to.
- `dtype` (Number) `TLSA` matching type.
- `host` (String) The host/subdomain.
- `id` (String) The record's numeric id, as a string.
- `port` (Number) `SRV` port.
- `priority` (Number) `MX`/`SRV` preference.
- `selector` (Number) `TLSA` selector.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds.
- `type` (String) The record type.
- `usage` (Number) `TLSA` usage.
- `weight` (Number) `SRV` weight.
